study_scope: deterministic reduced-order 2-D simulation; FR3/arm6 cases are actuator-geometry surrogates, not rigid-body or hardware validation

no_saturation.description: small nominal motion; manager should remain nearly inactive

directional_collapse.description: loss of authority primarily in task y direction

point_of_no_return.description: initial outward velocity near the position boundary

preview_mismatch.description: force changes sign inside the prediction horizon

horizon_ramp.description: dedicated horizon ablation: command step precedes a future actuator-budget drop

policy_training.rl_policy: deterministic small evolution-strategy policy search on a nominal double integrator; not a deep-RL benchmark
policy_training.neural_policy: fixed-hidden-layer neural policy fit to impedance-controller demonstrations
policy_training.ai_conditioned_proxy: scripted behavior primitive plus PD executor; software-interface case only, not an AI-performance result
